text:
alex: Customer reports tool call failing with a 400 from our tool-args schema validator after pasting payload from Windows. Says it worked locally then failed when sent to API. Paste below.

alex: ```json
{
  "file_path": "C:\Users\J.Doe\Documents\payload.json",
  "metadata": "Invoice copy (urgent),",
  "pages": [1,2,3],
}
```

kim: I tried reproing with the exact bytes. Server returns: `400 Bad Request - invalid JSON at position 56`

lee: Looks like two issues: 1) there's a trailing comma after the array, 2) the metadata string contains a non-breaking space (U+00A0) before the parentheses which some clients encode differently. When I replace the NBSP with normal space and remove trailing comma it parses fine. :mag_right:

alex: curl I used to repro: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d @payload.json
```

kim: Minimal server-side stack trace: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 4 column 1 (char 56)` — position aligns with the trailing comma. But the NBSP causes content mismatch in our client-side sanitizer so users see a different error message.

lee: Quick local check: `xxd -g 1 payload.json | sed -n '1,6p'` shows 0xc2 0xa0 in the string. Also saw CRLF endings (
) from Windows paste which some of our parsers tolerate but combined with weird whitespace it trips.

alex: Customer repro attached; wants either better error message or automatic whitespace normalization.

kim: Proposal: validate earlier in ingress: run a normalize step that replaces NBSP ( ) with normal space and fails fast on trailing commas with a clearer error. Filing internal issue INFR-7842 and pinging @eng-runtime for prioritization. :arrow_up:

support-bot: Created ticket INC-2026: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026 - Escalated from support thread 1768642100

lee: Workaround for now (shared with customer): `tr '\r' '\n' < payload.json | python -c 'import sys;print(sys.stdin.read().replace(' ',' '))' > payload_fixed.json` then send. Short but effective.

alex: Adding sample failing payload + hex dump to the Jira. Also note this only crops up when customers paste from certain editors (Notepad/Word) into our UI.

kim: Thanks — assigning to eng-runtime triage. If we bulk-normalize we should add a log flag so we can track how often and revert if it hides real input problems. :thinking:

lee: I'll drop a tiny reproducer script in the ticket.

alex: Cool, closing loop with customer and will follow up once INC-2026 has a plan. :white_check_mark:
